name: media_split
description: Split one video or audio file into several files: every N seconds (segment_length), into N equal parts (parts), or at given timestamps (at). Useful for making clips for social media, chunking long recordings for transcription, or cutting a video at chapter points. Parts are named <name>_part001, _part002, … in the output folder.

input.description: Path of the video or audio file, relative to the workspace.

segment_length.description: For mode segment_length: length of each part, e.g. "60" or "10:00". Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

parts.description: For mode parts: how many equal parts (2–500).

at.description: For mode at: increasing timestamps to split at. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output_dir.description: Folder for the parts, relative to the workspace. Default <name>_parts next to the input.

cut.description: accurate (default, re-encodes, exact) or fast (no re-encoding, cuts at keyframes).

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.
